cards.card_text: His wisdom is greater than all the men of the East and all the wisdom of Egypt, wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and wiser than Heman, Calcol and Darda, the sons of Mahol.
cards.verse_text: He was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and wiser than Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol.
cards.snippet: He was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and wiser than Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol.

cards.card_text: Psalm 88 is a song of the sons of Korah, a Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
cards.verse_text: A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
cards.snippet: A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.

cards.card_text: This psalm comes from Ethan the Ezrahite, and he's talking to the LORD.
